# Our Mission
:::

::: {.section-block}

## Mission Statement
ODA exists to expand real opportunities, drive sustainable development, and hold leadership accountable to the people of Owo/Ose - turning years of public service and community work into a platform that puts people first.

## Our Vision

A future where every constituent in Owo/Ose has access to opportunity, sees tangible development in their community, and can trust that their representative answers to them.

## Our Approach
- Opportunities
- Development
- Accountability

:::
